methodology.raw_score: Expected final score: official live points × projected multiplier after confirmed-DNP autosubs.
methodology.live_score: Raw score minus transfer hit cost; this net score drives live rank.
methodology.live_overall: Official total minus official GW total, plus calculated live GW score.
methodology.damage_per_point: League-average multiplier minus your multiplier, floored at zero.
methodology.remaining: Expected counting picks whose club fixture is live, upcoming or awaiting status. Autosubs project only after a starter's full GW schedule is complete on zero minutes and an eligible bench player has appeared.
methodology.autosubs: Provisional FPL bench-order and legal-formation projection; official scores may update later.
methodology.fixture_context: Each tracked player carries their live or next GW fixture, kickoff, opponent, minutes, GW points and realised EO-adjusted impact.
